Part 1: Loading datasets into R
```{r}
player_history <- read_csv("data/processed/steamidx_player_history.csv")
steamidx_games <- read_csv("data/processed/steamidx_games.csv")
fronkongames <- read_csv("data/processed/fronkongames_steam-games.csv")
```

```{r}
head(player_history)
head(steamidx_games)
head(fronkongames)
```

```{r}
summary(player_history)

player_history %>% count(app_id) %>% summary() # observatios per game

player_history %>%
  summarise(
    earliest_date = min(observed_at),
    latest_date = max(observed_at),
    unique_games = n_distinct(app_id),
    total_observations = n()
  )
```

Part 2: Engineering features for player_history

Checking some stuff first before engineering features
```{r}
player_history <- player_history %>% mutate(observed_at = as.Date(observed_at))

player_history %>% count(app_id, observed_at) %>% filter(n > 1) # check for potential records for same game on same date
```
```{r}
player_features <- player_history %>% group_by(app_id) %>% arrange(observed_at) %>%
  summarise(
    start_date = min(observed_at), # first recorded date of data
    end_date = max(observed_at), # last recorded date of data
    observations = n(), # number of observations for a game
    timespan = as.numeric(end_date - start_date) + 1, # amount of days between start and end dates
    coverage_percent = round((observations / timespan) * 100, 2), # % of days covered by observation_days in overall timespan of recorded data

    avg_players = round(mean(players, na.rm = TRUE), 3), 
    median_players = round(median(players, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    sd_players = round(sd(players, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    min_players = min(players, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_players = max(players, na.rm = TRUE),

    zero_percent = round(mean(players == 0, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 2), # % of observations w/ zero players
    first_players = first(players), # amount of players on first observation of a game
    last_players = last(players), # amount of players on last observation of a game
    absolute_change = last_players - first_players, # overall change in players throughout timespan
    percent_change = if_else(first_players != 0,
      round((last_players - first_players) / first_players * 100, 2), NA_real_
    ), # % change from first to last observation

    recent_7d_avg = round(mean(players[observed_at >= end_date - 6], na.rm = TRUE), 2), # most recent 7 day average
    recent_14d_avg = round(mean(players[observed_at >= end_date - 13], na.rm = TRUE), 2), # most recent 14 day average
    trend_slope = {
      day_index = as.numeric(observed_at - start_date)
      round(coef(lm(players ~ day_index))[2], 3)
    }, # estimated daily change in players over observation period

    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
head(player_features)

player_features %>% summary()

player_features %>% arrange(desc(avg_players)) %>% head() # games with highest avg concurrent player counts
player_features %>% arrange(desc(percent_change)) %>% head() # games with largest increases
player_features %>% arrange(percent_change) %>% head() # games with largest decreases
```
```{r}
write_csv(player_features, "data/processed/player_features.csv")
```

Part 3: Merging with AppID

Initial checks
```{r}
# check for any AppIDs with more than one row
steamidx_games %>% count(AppID) %>% filter(n > 1) 
fronkongames %>% count(AppID) %>% filter(n > 1)

class(player_features$app_id)
class(steamidx_games$AppID)
class(fronkongames$AppID)
```
Merging player_features with steamidx_games first
```{r}
player_features_merged <- player_features %>% left_join(steamidx_games, by = c("app_id" = "AppID")) # left join players_features into steamidx_games

nrow(player_features)
nrow(player_features_merged)

player_features_merged %>%
  summarise(
    total_games = n(),
    matched_games = sum(!is.na(Name)),
    unmatched_games = sum(is.na(Name))
  )

player_features_merged %>% count(app_id) %>% filter(n > 1) # check for duplicated games if any
```
Then merging into fronkongames
```{r}
names(fronkongames)

fronk_selected <- fronkongames %>%
  select(
    AppID,
    "Price",
    "DLC count",
    "Metacritic score",
    "Achievements",
    "Recommendations",
    "Average playtime two weeks",
    "Average playtime forever",
    "Median playtime two weeks",
    "Median playtime forever",
  ) %>% mutate(fronk_match = TRUE)

head(fronk_selected)

player_features_merged2 <- player_features_merged %>% left_join(fronk_selected, by = c("app_id" = "AppID"))
```

```{r}
player_features_merged2 %>%
  summarise(
    total_games = n(),
    matched_fronk = sum(!is.na(fronk_match)),
    unmatched_fronk = sum(is.na(fronk_match)),
    match_percent = round(mean(!is.na(fronk_match)) * 100, 2)
  )

write_csv(player_features_merged2, "data/processed/player_features_steamidx-fronk_merged.csv")
```
